decision.summary: Keep the smaller validated-record boundary and removal of duplicate work. This comparison does not establish an end-to-end latency gain. Candidate Yao median exceeded both controls. Whole-invocation preparation CPU was lower in the candidate, but it does not isolate the removed checks.
decision.remainingTarget: Registration to independently verified NEAR signature below 3–4 seconds remains unmet.
decision.nextWork: Measure the backend stages of registration setup and credential submission. The preceding restored control measured these HTTP requests at 602 ms and 674 ms median. Their internal dependencies were not traced in this experiment; do not merge requests or remove fresh authorization checks without that dependency review.

method: Three fresh implicit, unfunded NEAR wallets per sequential baseline/candidate/restored-baseline arm. Matching corrected NEP-413 SDK, Gateway, Runtime, Console, Router, Signing Worker, configuration and requested APAC placement stayed fixed. Only Deriver A and B changed. Builds and local verification completed before timed browser runs.

preservedChecksReview.change: Consume the authenticated root record directly as a sealed online share. Remove duplicate record-shape and activation-binding validation inside the same load.
retainedChecks: open_row rejects invalid revision and decrypts the exact persisted row.
cipher.open validates the record and activation binding before returning it.
verify_bound_row matches identity, lineage, epoch, role, commitment and activation receipt against authenticated custody.
The admission write retains its preliminary authenticated read and conditional SQL predicate.
Execution retains fresh cancellation, active uniqueness, retirement and erasure checks.
Provider decryption verifies the secret share against its public commitment before preparation or execution.
ECDSA settlement still races cancellation before use.
An unchanged request-local snapshot can be reused only when all persisted fields match.
preservedChecksReview.removedWorkPerSuccessfulLoad: Two repeated record validation calls, two repeated activation-binding validation calls, and one repeated revision check.

independentSignatureVerification.verifier: Node.js crypto Ed25519 with independent NEP-413 Borsh encoding

setupAttempt.cause: GitHub OIDC token endpoint returned HTTP 504
setupAttempt.retryPolicy: Retry the staging comparison once after original activation is restored.

limitations: Three samples per arm do not establish percentiles, statistical significance or a latency guarantee.
Sequential arms are exposed to provider scheduling and network variation.
All captured serving versions must match the expected cohort. No failed or mismatched sample is excluded.
Fresh wallets do not prove cold Workers. Worker cold starts were not controlled.
Nested spans overlap. Protocol spans include transport and are not pure CPU measurements.
Whole-invocation CPU measurements cannot isolate the removed validation work.
Worker clocks do not advance during synchronous CPU work. Zero spans do not imply zero work.
Bound-root D1 counters cover admission and execution, not all D1 work in the full flow.
Requested APAC placement does not prove physical colocation.
